item.title: WVU Medicine Children's receives $10,000 check for balloons
item.description: WVU Medicine Golisano Children's Hospital received a $10,000 check Friday morning, specifically to buy balloons.

item.title: How the Monongalia County Health Department is giving kids a smile
item.description: For the past 16 years, the Monongalia County Health Department (MCHD) has offered dental care to local kids who need it, and Friday was no different.

item.title: Pileup shuts down I-79 in Lewis County
item.description: Interstate 79 is shut down in both directions in Lewis County Friday night amid heavy winter conditions in the region.

item.title: Winter weather poses risks for West Virginians with Alzheimer's
item.description: More than 38,100 West Virginians live with Alzheimer's and other dementias, and as winter weather rages in, the Alzheimer's Association is encouraging people to check in on their neighbors and loved ones with the disease.

item.title: Morgantown man charged after task force members find fentanyl in his anus
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges after task force members in Morgantown say they found him in possession of drugs, including inside his body.

item.title: WVU students alerted after reports of suspicious person
item.description: According to a press release from WVU, campus police began foot patrols after receiving separate reports at roughly 12:50 a.m. and 1:55 a.m., despite access to Braxton Tower requiring WVU ID swipes at the entry door and elevators.

item.title: State board approves Tucker County data center air quality permit
item.description: The West Virginia Air Quality Board ruled Thursday against a community group's objection to an air quality permit for the Ridgeline power plant and data center in Tucker County.

item.title: Barbour County pair charged after kids found in home littered with trash, feces
item.description: A Barbour County pair has been arrested and is facing charges after deputies say they found children in their care inside a home littered with feces and trash.

item.title: Goat barn burns down in Harrison County
item.description: A goat barn burned to the ground in rural Harrison County on Friday.
